canonical_example.text: Mete reversa y lentamente quita el pie del freno.
canonical_example.translation: Put it in reverse and slowly take your foot off the brake.

canonical_example.text: Mi tío me metió en su empresa.
canonical_example.translation: My uncle got me a job at his company.

canonical_example.text: No me gustó como me quedó el dibujo, así que le metí las tijeras.
canonical_example.translation: I didn't like how my drawing turned out, so I took the scissors to it.

canonical_example.text: El boxeador le metió un golpe tan duro a su contrincante que se cayó.
canonical_example.translation: The boxer gave his opponent such a hard punch that he fell over.

canonical_example.text: Me metió un susto cuando se explotó el transformador en la calle.
canonical_example.translation: It gave me a fright when the transformer exploded in the street.

canonical_example.text: Empezó a llover y se metieron en la casa.
canonical_example.translation: It started raining and they went in the house.

canonical_example.text: Nos metimos por un callejón sin salida.
canonical_example.translation: We went down a blind alley.

canonical_example.text: Estoy tan cansada que tengo ganas de meterme en la cama.
canonical_example.translation: I'm so tired I just want to get into bed.

canonical_example.text: ¿Dónde se habrán metido esas llaves?
canonical_example.translation: Where can those keys have gotten to?

canonical_example.text: Imelda se metió a la política cuando su familia perdió todo por un político corrupto.
canonical_example.translation: Imelda got involved in politics when her family lost everything because of a corrupt politician.

canonical_example.translation: After her first trip to the coast at age 12, Rose got into diving.

canonical_example.text: Rafa siempre se mete en donde no debe.
canonical_example.translation: Rafa's always interfering where he’s not wanted.

canonical_example.text: ¿No tienes nada mejor que hacer que meterte en nuestro proyecto?
canonical_example.translation: Don’t you have anything better to do than meddle in our project?

canonical_example.text: No te metas donde no debes.
canonical_example.translation: Don't stick your nose in where it's not wanted.

canonical_example.text: Deja de meterte con los niños más chicos.
canonical_example.translation: Stop picking on the smaller children.

canonical_example.translation: He decided to become a doctor like his uncle.

canonical_example.text: Federico se metió a mesero.

canonical_example.translation: He ruined his life when he started doing cocaine.

canonical_example.text: ¿Sabías que se puede medir el brillo de las estrellas?

canonical_example.translation: The sun's brilliance won't let me see the road well.

canonical_example.translation: That shampoo gives your hair an incredible shine.

canonical_example.text: No me gusta el brillo que tiene este tejido.
canonical_example.translation: I don't like the sheen on this fabric.

canonical_example.text: El platino resalta el brillo de los diamantes.

canonical_example.translation: The sun shone over the desert.

canonical_example.text: En mi humilde opinión, ese vestido tiene demasiado brillo con tanta lentejuela.
canonical_example.translation: In my humble opinion, that dress has too much glitter with all those sequins.

canonical_example.translation: Do you prefer your photos with a matt or with a gloss finish?

canonical_example.translation: I bought a strawberry lip gloss.

canonical_example.text: A uñas cortas, un poquito de brillo les queda fenomenal.
canonical_example.translation: A little clear nail polish looks great on short nails.

canonical_example.translation: He had had enough of the splendor of the jet-setting crowd.

canonical_example.translation: The splendour of the Spanish court disappeared with the last of the Habsburg monarchs.

canonical_example.text: Tus ojos brillan como las estrellas.
canonical_example.translation: Your eyes sparkle like stars.

canonical_example.text: La nieve brillaba con la luz del sol.
canonical_example.translation: The snow glistened in the sunlight.

canonical_example.text: El dorado del vestido brillaba bajo la luz.
canonical_example.translation: The gilt on the dress glittered under the light.

canonical_example.text: Carolina brilló en el concurso de matemáticas.
canonical_example.translation: Carolina shone in the math competition.

canonical_example.translation: Alexander stands out in salsa class; you can see he loves to dance.

canonical_example.text: Llega a una hora conveniente: ni muy temprano ni muy tarde.
canonical_example.translation: Arrive at a convenient time: not too early, not too late.

canonical_example.text: Es conveniente llegar con 15 minutos de antelación para evitar largas filas.
canonical_example.translation: It is advisable to arrive to 15 minutes in advance to avoid a long line.

canonical_example.text: Sería conveniente si llegaras a la oficina 30 minutos antes de la entrevista.
canonical_example.translation: It would be a good idea for you to arrive to the office 30 minutes before your interview.

canonical_example.text: Se lastimaron porque no tomaron las precauciones convenientes.
canonical_example.translation: They got injured because they didn't take the proper precautions.

canonical_example.translation: A more appropriate response to the crisis would be to set up more preventative measures.

canonical_example.text: El Gran Hotel será un lugar conveniente para realizar la convención.
canonical_example.translation: The Grand Hotel will be a suitable location for the convention.

canonical_example.text: Posee una mente brillante, pero carece de autodisciplina.
canonical_example.translation: She has a brilliant mind but lacks self-discipline.

canonical_example.text: Poseo tres coches pero solo suelo manejar uno.
canonical_example.translation: I own three cars but I usually only drive one.

canonical_example.text: Poseo un máster en Recursos Humanos.
canonical_example.translation: I hold a Master's degree in Human Resources.

canonical_example.text: Fue poseído de rabia después de perder el apuesto de un millón de dólares.
canonical_example.translation: He was possessed by rage after losing the million-dollar wager.

canonical_example.text: El gato himalayo, Tinker Toy, posee el récord de ser el gato más pequeño del mundo.
canonical_example.translation: The Himalayan cat, Tinker Toy, holds the record for being the world's smallest cat.

canonical_example.text: "La poseeré algún día," dijo el duque, señalando a la aldeana.
canonical_example.translation: "I will possess her one day," said the duke, pointing to the village girl.

canonical_example.text: Mario Vargas Llosa es un reconocido novelista.
canonical_example.translation: Mario Vargas Llosa is a recognized novelist.

canonical_example.text: El curso que voy a tomar está reconocido internacionalmente.
canonical_example.translation: The course I'll be taking is internationally recognised.

canonical_example.translation: A well-known pediatrician advised against the operation.

canonical_example.text: Pudo reconocer al ladrón en cuanto lo vio.
canonical_example.translation: She was able to recognize the thief as soon as she saw him.

canonical_example.text: ¿Me reconoces en esta foto?
canonical_example.translation: Can you recognise me in this photo?

canonical_example.text: Mi padre reconoció que se había equivocado.
canonical_example.translation: My father admitted that he was wrong.

canonical_example.text: En algunos países no se reconocen los derechos humanos.
canonical_example.translation: In some countries, human rights are not recognized.

canonical_example.text: Mi hermana es una reconocida experta en economía.
canonical_example.translation: My sister is an acknowledged expert on economics.

canonical_example.text: Estoy muy reconocida con el profesor que me ayudó.
canonical_example.translation: I am very grateful to the teacher who helped me.

canonical_example.text: Algunos países reconocen a Palestina como un estado.
canonical_example.translation: Some countries recognise Palestine as a state.

canonical_example.text: El padre no quiso reconocerla como su hija.
canonical_example.translation: The father didn't want to acknowledge her as his daugther.

canonical_example.text: El médico reconoció al paciente.
canonical_example.translation: The doctor examined the patient.

canonical_example.text: Necesitamos mover la mesa al otro lado del salón.
canonical_example.translation: We need to move the table to the other side of the room.

canonical_example.text: Este es el mecanismo que mueve el péndulo del reloj.
canonical_example.translation: This is the mechanism that moves the pendulum of the clock.
